meta.name: tool-calling-tutor
meta.description: Use when a tool-calling agent does not call a tool, sends wrong arguments, loops without stopping, or needs a function schema. Guides a four-branch diagnosis and five-step schema repair. Do not use for framework-specific, MCP-server, or production-observability questions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定位AI不调用工具或卡死循环的根因并修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发AI智能体,且常遇到工具调用出错或卡循环。
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose and fix AI agent tool-calling failures and loops.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build AI agents and often see tool-calling errors or endless loops.

howto.what: 引导你从四种症状中选一个,再按对应分支排查修复:改写工具描述、修正参数类型/必填项、检查控制流,或用五步法设计新 schema。它不直接写代码,而是带你看参考文档和示例。
howto.when: 当你说到 LLM 不调用工具、参数传错、循环跑不停等关键词,或要求设计函数 schema 时触发。

say.text: 我的 LLM 不调用工具,只回文本
帮我看看这个 function schema 哪里写坏了
设计一个新工具,给我 schema 建议
say.note: 它会用五步法陪你设计

howto.what_en: Guides you to pick one of four symptoms, then walks through branch-specific fixes: rewriting tool descriptions, correcting parameter types/required fields, checking control flow, or designing a new schema with a five-step method. It does not write code for you; it points to references and examples.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention tool-calling issues like the LLM not calling a tool, wrong arguments, an endless ReAct loop, or needing a function schema.

say_en.text: My LLM doesn't call any tools, it just replies with text.
Help me see what's wrong with this function schema.
say_en.note: It asks you to pick a symptom first.

say_en.text: Design a new tool and advise on its schema.
